excluded_rigid_groups.name: Rigid Group 2
excluded_rigid_groups.reason: This single leg-1 group contains all 16 leg occurrences and contradicts the same assembly's three live revolute joints; treating it as connectivity would collapse the articulated chain.

reasons.adapter_ownership: Servo-1 ara is assigned to mount and servo-3 ara to femur. Fusion has no rigid group for those adapters, so their sides are explicit reviewed topology overrides.
reasons.fixed_mounts: The archive exposes no body-to-leg joint or grounding state. Each first servo occurrence is explicitly fixed to the body so this required attachment is visible and reviewable rather than inferred in the generator.
reasons.foot_contacts: The Fusion model has no contact marker. The deterministic selector uses the visible Final_leg_tip geometry and is recorded explicitly instead of silently guessing a point.
reasons.joint_roles: Fusion uses generic Revolute 2/5/6 names; exact context and both connected occurrences lock each semantic role without relying on names alone.
reasons.rigid_groups: Fusion contains one broad contradictory leg-1 group. The reviewed assignments instead use the three revolute boundaries, servo subassembly rigidity, Rigid Group 3 for the tip/third-servo housing, and Rigid Group 4 for each housing/bracket and the base/second-servo assembly.

review.evidence: All 18 joint roles, canonical signs, visual coverage, contradictory rigid-group exclusion, and ambiguous servo adapter ownership were checked against fusion_snapshot.v1.json.

review_notes: Overrides are allowed only where Fusion connectivity or contact intent is genuinely ambiguous.
Promotion is rejected until the exact entities, ownership, and selector are independently reviewed.

coordinate_system.assembly_frame_note: The Fusion root assembly is already Y-up; applying the standalone mesh map again is a double rotation.
